_comment: Explicit redirect targets for profiles DELIBERATELY removed from the vault (not renamed, not purged as a phantom twin — genuinely removed because the evidence did not support them). The emit-git-slug-redirects.mjs guard matches a vanished live URL to a successor by display_name / vault_file / tagset / namekey. A removed person has NO successor by any of those keys, so without this file the guard correctly refuses to emit a partial redirect set and the regen fails closed. Add an entry here ONLY with a reason and a date, and only after the removal is recorded in the vault's Corrections Log.

<old-slug>.to: <slug of the page a visitor should land on, or null for a soft 410-style notice>
<old-slug>.corrections_log: the Corrections Log heading that records this removal

esther-naomi-lynette-telfer-1983.reason: Date correction, not a removal. The page was titled (b. 1983) from a bad OCR read of '6 Mar 1983' in the 2008 Supplement's scan-derived text layer. Two independent sources print 1993: the 1989 book's text layer ('b. 6 Mar 1993 Tumby Bay, SA') and a direct reading of the Supplement's printed page 145. The Supplement scan's OCR layer misread the 9 as an 8. Page retitled to 1993.
esther-naomi-lynette-telfer-1983.corrections_log: 2026-10-25 — CORRECTION: Esther Naomi Lynette Telfer birth year 1983 → 1993 (OCR misread, two sources agree)

donald-rex-fatchen-1957.reason: SLUG RENAME, not a removal — and the old slug carried two faults at once. (1) The GIVEN NAME was wrong: this man is Ronald Rex Fatchen, not Donald. B2 (From the Borders to the Bush) printed p.174 was read from the PAGE IMAGE by two independent engines — WeVisDoc-2B (local) and Gemini vision (cloud) — across three renders at 9x and 12x magnification; both read 'Ronald Rex Fatchen' on every render and neither ever read 'Donald'. (2) The trailing YEAR in the slug was wrong: 1957 was a marriage-era date sitting in his birth-date cell, not a birth. That date has been withdrawn rather than guessed, and the vault now states plainly that B2 prints no birth date for him at all. The person is unchanged and has his own vault note ('Ronald Rex Fatchen.md'). 'Donald' survives correctly only as the MIDDLE name of his son Bradley Donald Fatchen. Recorded in the vault Corrections Log, 2026-10-27.
donald-rex-fatchen-1957.corrections_log: 2026-10-27 — CORRECTION: 'Donald Rex Fatchen' was Ronald Rex Fatchen; birth date 17 Dec 1957 withdrawn (was a marriage-era date, no birth date printed in B2)
